name: Community Suite (All-in-One)
description: All custom apps in one build: Music + Internet Radio + QR Remote, Alarm/Timer/Stopwatch, Gemini Live, MCP Bridge, unified Home/Volume top bar, and MicroSD custom avatars (/sd/avatars).

name: Music Player
description: Play MP3 music directly from the MicroSD card with track browsing, album controls, and background playback.

name: Alarm Clock
description: Native alarm clock with RTC sync, countdown timer, stopwatch with lap splits, synth tones, and MicroSD MP3 alarms.

name: Gemini Live
description: Real-time hands-free voice assistant powered by Gemini Live API with adaptive VAD and configurable voice settings.

name: MCP Bridge
description: Voice and robot bridge connecting StackChan to desktop AI agents over MCP for speech, expressions, camera, and motion.
